pages.text: 清晨的阳光照进窗户，咘咘一骨碌爬起来，开心地喊：“我要去幼儿园啦！”NOMI帮她整理好小书包，NONO在她肩膀上叽叽喳喳。
pages.text_en: Morning sunlight streamed through the window. Bubu jumped out of bed excitedly: "I'm going to kindergarten!" NOMI helped her pack her little backpack while NONO chirped on her shoulder.

pages.text: 幼儿园门口，艳艳老师已经笑眯眯地等着了。“咘咘早上好呀！”艳艳老师弯下腰，温柔地摸摸咘咘的头。
pages.text_en: At the kindergarten gate, Teacher Yanyan was already waiting with a warm smile. "Good morning, Bubu!" She bent down and gently patted Bubu's head.

pages.text: 旁边站着一位新老师——张老师！她是一只漂亮的小鹿，穿着浅蓝色上衣和白围裙。“大家好，我是张老师，以后和艳艳老师一起照顾你们哦！”
pages.text_en: Standing beside her was a new teacher — Teacher Zhang! She was a pretty young deer in a light blue top and white apron. "Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Zhang. I'll be taking care of you together with Teacher Yanyan!"

pages.text: “咘咘！咘咘！”矮矮胖胖的墨鱼摇着小短腿跑过来，后面跟着灰白色的菲菲。三个好朋友紧紧抱在一起，开心极了！
pages.text_en: "Bubu! Bubu!" Chubby little Moyu waddled over on her short legs, followed by grey-and-white Feifei. The three best friends hugged each other tightly, so happy to be together!

pages.text: 上课啦！张老师拿出一本大大的图画书，小朋友们围坐在一起。咘咘、墨鱼和菲菲挨着坐在最前排，眼睛睁得大大的。
pages.text_en: Class time! Teacher Zhang held up a big picture book and the children gathered around. Bubu, Moyu, and Feifei sat together in the front row, their eyes wide with wonder.

pages.text: 艳艳老师教大家唱歌。咘咘拍着小手，墨鱼摇着短尾巴，菲菲竖起耳朵打着节拍。NONO也在旁边跟着拍翅膀！
pages.text_en: Teacher Yanyan taught everyone to sing. Bubu clapped her little paws, Moyu wagged her short tail, and Feifei twitched her ears to the beat. NONO flapped his wings along too!

pages.text: 画画课上，三个好朋友一起画了一幅大画。咘咘画了太阳，墨鱼画了花朵，菲菲画了蝴蝶。张老师看了直鼓掌：“画得太棒啦！”
pages.text_en: During art class, the three friends worked on a big painting together. Bubu drew the sun, Moyu drew flowers, and Feifei drew butterflies. Teacher Zhang clapped: "What a wonderful painting!"

pages.text: 午饭时间到！艳艳老师给每个小朋友盛好饭菜。咘咘吃得好香，墨鱼把碗里的饭全吃光了，菲菲还想再添一碗汤。
pages.text_en: Lunchtime! Teacher Yanyan served food for every child. Bubu ate happily, Moyu finished every last bite, and Feifei asked for another bowl of soup.

pages.text: 午睡时间，张老师轻轻拉上窗帘，放起柔柔的音乐。咘咘和菲菲挨着睡，墨鱼已经打起了小呼噜。NOMI坐在角落看着她们，微微笑着。
pages.text_en: Nap time. Teacher Zhang gently drew the curtains and played soft music. Bubu and Feifei napped side by side while Moyu was already snoring softly. NOMI sat in the corner watching over them with a gentle smile.

pages.text: 午睡醒来，大家一起到操场玩！咘咘和墨鱼玩滑梯，菲菲在荡秋千。两位老师在旁边看着，笑得好开心。
pages.text_en: After nap time, everyone went to the playground! Bubu and Moyu played on the slide while Feifei swung on the swings. Both teachers watched nearby, smiling happily.

pages.text: 咘咘拉着墨鱼和菲菲的手，三个人一起转圈圈。“我们是最好的朋友！”咘咘笑着说。NONO在她们头顶飞来飞去，洒下快乐的歌声。
pages.text_en: Bubu held Moyu's and Feifei's hands, and the three of them spun in circles. "We're the best of friends!" Bubu said with a laugh. NONO flew above them, singing a happy song.

pages.text: 放学了，爸爸来接咘咘。“爸爸！今天好开心！我有两个老师，两个好朋友！”咘咘扑进爸爸的怀里，把一天的故事都讲给他听。
pages.text_en: School was over, and Daddy came to pick Bubu up. "Daddy! Today was so much fun! I have two teachers and two best friends!" Bubu leaped into Daddy's arms, telling him all about her wonderful day.

pages.text: 回到家，咘咘画了一幅画：画面上有艳艳老师、张老师、墨鱼、菲菲，还有她自己。她在画上写了歪歪扭扭的字：“我的幼儿园，我的朋友们。”
pages.text_en: Back home, Bubu drew a picture: Teacher Yanyan, Teacher Zhang, Moyu, Feifei, and herself. She wrote wobbly words on it: "My kindergarten, my friends."

pages.text: 夜晚，咘咘抱着NOMI，NONO停在床头。“明天还要去幼儿园哦，”咘咘小声说，“因为老师和朋友们都在等我呀。”说完，她甜甜地睡着了。
pages.text_en: That night, Bubu hugged NOMI while NONO perched on the headboard. "I want to go to kindergarten again tomorrow," Bubu whispered, "because my teachers and friends are all waiting for me." With that, she fell sweetly asleep.
